target.text: The result at site A was 30 units.

materials.content: The notice reports that site A produced 30 units. Source: https://fixture.example/record-f
Measurement record: site B produced 30 units; site A produced 20 units.

basis.quote: Measurement record: site B produced 30 units; site A produced 20 units.
The notice reports that site A produced 30 units.

raw_response.rationale: Both materials are available before the 2026-01-03 cutoff. The target's source, notice-f, cites record-f as its source. That primary measurement record attributes 30 units to site B and 20 units to site A, so the exact target (30 units at site A) is directly negated by the record the notice itself relies on; the notice appears to have transposed the site attribution. The notice is a downstream report of the same record and cannot independently confirm a figure the record does not contain. The eligible evidence settles the claim against the target.
